content: Yesu Ənga Zakka
Yesu vu Yariko, ja vǝr tǝrabiya wu hu ɗa mǝlma nyi,
kǝ ja vanyi ndǝ dǝgal nǝ njir tsǝm budau, kǝra nja ngga ǝnga Zakka. Naja tsu ndǝr gǝnna,
ji ɗa aga ja lari tara wa ngǝ Yesu, ama naji sǝni lari nyi mai ara naja ndǝ tashu, ǝnga tsu nji gangǝ gagaɗau.
Agabangǝ kǝ ji maˈyi a dumwa ǝnga hwi, kǝ ji thlǝwa wu bǝla kǝ ji dagwa, aga ja lari nyi, arya Yesu wu nda tǝrabiya lagu ta.
Ənggǝra Yesu thlǝwa vi ta, kǝ ji hyaˈanakǝr a dǝmǝlmau ji na, “Zakka, kusa ga shida! Əshina yu ɗa mǝthlǝpi wu ki ngau.”
Zakka gya ǝnga kusa, ji dlǝwuri nyi ǝnga huɗǝ pipida.
Ənggǝra nji lari abangau, kǝ ndǝ mbari ngwungwuni, nda vǝr na, “Kǝja! Wu ki ndǝr bikǝ nga ji ɗa mǝthlǝpi.”

Kǝ Zakka hyaˈari aˈyi taˈyau, ji na anǝ Thlagǝu, “Nggari, ndǝ dǝgal, yu tǝkǝya sǝra ara yau bwata mǝthlǝu, ba ya tǝkǝna pathla nyi anǝ nji tǝtǝ dǝnama. Patǝkura njira nyi dlǝrbǝri, yu nda shabiya nda sǝr nda aga foɗǝu.”
Kǝ Yesu na anǝ nyi, “Əshina ma, mbǝɗau a shiliri wu ki kau, naja ma culi Ibrahimu ngau.
Arya Zǝr Ndau ji shili aga sa gal nji sasa, ǝnga ja sa canǝ nda lagur mbǝɗau.”
Karapau Nǝ Pam Kumou
Tsu nda vǝr sǝ himi sǝˈyar kau, kǝ Yesu dumwa ǝnga na vanyi karapǝ anǝ nda, ara a ɗar lǝhǝu wu dzǝri Urshalima, ǝnga nja vǝr ɗǝnga abǝr tǝlkur Hyal wu cabiya dzǝ aga zǝmǝu.
Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Nji sayi mǝliya vanyi ndǝ dǝgal kǝra maˈyi a ndu vanyi mǝlmǝ naɗǝ aga nja fiya nyi tǝl ja dzǝgwa sha shili.
Kadivira ja mai, ji ngga kumo wu pama mafa nyiˈyar, ji nǝ nda pam papathlǝ ji dzǝgwa na anǝ nda, ‘Shafǝli mau ǝni kǝl yi sha shili.’
Njir mǝlmǝ nyi wu yiwu nyi mai. Agabangau, kǝ ndǝ sǝwa cama ayukuɗa ji mai a ndu mǝlmǝ ta abǝr, ‘Naˈyu yiwu ndǝ kǝ ja ɗa tǝl ar kǝra ˈya mai.’
“Kǝ nji fiya ndǝ kǝ tǝl, ji dzǝgwa sha shili wu ki. Ənggǝra ji shili kǝ ji sǝwa nja nggari nyi mafa nyiˈyar ta, aga ja sǝni nubwa kǝra ndǝ uya ar kǝra sǝra ji nǝ nda.
Ndǝ tanggǝrma shili ji na, ‘Thlagǝu, a uyari yau nubwa pam kumo a dar kǝra pam pathlǝu ta gǝ nǝ ɗa ta.’

Kǝ thlagǝri ki kǝ na anǝ nyi, ‘Usi mafa tsapǝu ndǝr mǝl thlǝr tsaˈa miya ɗǝfu! Gǝ mǝl thlǝr ngau, tsaˈa miya ɗǝfu ǝnga sǝ kushu kǝra nji nǝ ngau, yu mǝliya ga sǝm tǝlkur ar kǝra mǝlmǝ pamǝpamǝ kumou.’
Mafa nǝ mǝthlǝkura nyi shili ji na, ‘Thlagǝu, a uyari yau nubwa pamǝ tǝfu a dar kǝra pamǝ zǝmǝ ta gǝ nǝ ɗa ta.’
Thlagǝr ki nyi shaɗǝwa anǝ ndǝ kau, ‘Gǝ wu sǝm tǝlkur ar kǝra mǝlmǝ pamǝpamǝ tǝfu.’
“Kǝ vanyi mafa shili ji na, ‘Thlagǝu, kǝ ja pamǝ zǝmǝ ngau. Yi pǝɗiya wu kukuzhal, yi ɗǝwana.
Ara yu hivǝr ngau, arya na gǝ ndǝ dzadzau ngau. Kǝja ga fa sǝra kǝra nǝ gau, gu gǝm tsu sǝra gǝ kǝra thlǝka na.’

Kǝ ji na anǝ nyi, ‘Nagǝ mafa ɗǝmwaˈyi hangǝkal, yu mǝliya ngǝ numa ǝnga sǝra biya sara wu miya gau! Əngwar gau nayi ndǝra nji kǝra sǝni hangǝkal nyi, ndǝr fa sǝ nji kurthlǝu ǝnga yiwu gǝm ar vi kǝra yi kǝra thlǝka na.
Tsaˈa nga nyi, ama mi ngǝ ɗa nagǝ fiya gǝnna ɗa ar vi fǝ gǝnna maya, aga maˈyi shili ya uya akkǝri ar kǝri mai ya?’
“Kǝ ji na anǝ nji ta taˈyi ǝkkǝˈyi ja, ‘Dlǝwura mau gǝnna dubu pathlǝu kǝra ara ja kau, ba hya nǝ nyi anǝ ndǝra ǝnga dubu kumou.’
Ama kǝ ndǝ shaɗǝwa nyi, ndǝ na, ‘Thlagǝu, pamǝ kumo nga ara ja.’
Ji shaɗǝwa, ji na, ‘Yi wu nar hyi, ndǝra aˈyi ǝnga sau nju nda cakǝri nyi. Ndǝra kǝra aˈyi ǝnga sau, alaga sǝ kushu kǝra aˈyi ara ja nju nda dlǝwuri.
Njira dawa ɗa kau, nji kǝra gǝra yiwu ya ɗa tǝl ar kǝra nda kau, faˈari nda mau a shili nja tsǝya nda wu mwa ɗa.’ ”
Yesu Vu Urshalima
Ənggǝra ji nana abangau, kǝ ji dumwa a vu Urshalima.
Ənggǝra Yesu ǝnga zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar vu mǝlmǝ Bethfaji ǝnga Bethlani, mǝlmǝ kǝra lǝhǝu wu dzǝr Urshalima, kǝra a dar kǝra mǝ zaitunu. Kǝ Yesu sǝwa zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar mǝthlǝu,
Ji na anǝ nda, “Maˈya mau a vu zǝr mǝlmǝ kǝ a ndumwar hyi kau, ǝnggǝra hyi vwau, hyu vuwa thlǝwa zǝr kwara mbamba ar sǝˈyi, kǝra nji gǝra saya dari, hya pǝlna nyi hya hǝr ɗa a shili.
Ma nji yiwa hyi, ‘Mi ngǝ ɗa hyu mǝl abanga?’ Kǝl ba hya na, ‘Thlagǝ ngu yiwu ja mǝl thlǝr ǝni.’ ”
Njira nji sǝwa, ndǝ maˈyi, kǝ ndǝ thlǝwa kalar sau ǝnggǝra Yesu nar nda ta.
Nda vǝr pǝl nyi ja, kǝ thlagǝri kwara nyi na anǝ nda, “Aga mi nga hyu pǝl nya?”
Kǝ ndǝ na, “Thlagǝ ngu yiwu ja mǝl thlǝr ǝni.”
Kǝ ndǝ hǝri nyi a shila nǝ Yesu. Ənggǝra ndǝ fǝr lǝgutǝr nda a dar kwara nyi, kǝ ndǝ dlǝwari Yesu ndǝ fǝri nyi a dar ya kwara nyi.
Ənggǝra ja vǝr ɓau, kǝ nji dzǝgwa sǝya lǝgutǝr nda a gyar lagu.

Ənggǝra ji shili lǝhǝu wu dzǝri Urshalima, mǝ tsa ga vi kǝra lagu sa gya ar dza gar nǝ wur Zaitunu, kǝ daɓǝr zǝmbǝlma nyiˈyar gangǝu daɓau nda vǝr usa Hyal, nda vǝr fal nyi tsu ǝnga ɗahǝu ǝnga dǝnama arya sǝ dǝdǝgur pamǝpamǝ kǝra ndǝ lari.
Nda vǝr na!

content.text: kǝra wu dla wu thlǝmǝr Thlagǝu!

content: Kǝ alenyi njir Farisi kǝra wu pama nda na anǝ nyi, “Malǝmǝ, ga kughi anǝ zǝmbǝlma ngǝˈyar nda nggya zǝmǝu!”
Ji shaɗǝwa nda, ji na, “Ya nar hyi,” “alaga ndǝ bǝgau, tsǝka ˈyar kǝ ǝnga kǝr nda ndu wau.”
Yesu Tiwi Arya Urshalima
Ənggǝra ji shili lǝhǝu gagaɗau, ji tsamiya vu Urshalima, kǝ ji tiwi anǝ nyi.
Ji na, “Kara nggǝrau, ma ja hyi nda sǝni sǝra wu nǝ hyi nggya jamǝu! Ama kǝ ja a ɗar ɗǝɗǝwa ara hyi.
Pǝci a vǝr shili kǝra dawar hyu nda zǝwar hyu masǝmǝ nda dzǝgwa pa ǝnga hyi. Sojar nda ngu nda zǝwar hyi.
Ndu nda hǝradlǝna ngau ǝnga nja dlǝna njira a gwa patǝu. Nandǝ wu nda piyari tsǝka zǝmǝ ar kǝra kuvwa nyi mai. Sǝˈyar kǝ wu nda ɗa ǝnga hyi ara nahyi aˈyi sǝnbiya abǝr Hyal shili aga mbǝɗa hyi mai.”
Yesu A Gwu Ki Hyal
Kǝ Yesu vu ki Hyal ji vuwa kǝdlǝbiya njira vǝr ɗǝl ǝnga ɗǝlna sǝ a vuna patǝu,
ji na anǝ nda, “Tsǝtsǝfǝ nga nyi,
Parangǝ ja vǝr highiɓau wu ki Hyal. Ama pubu dǝdǝgalˈyar, ǝnga malǝmǝ dlaɗǝˈyar, ǝnga nji dǝdǝgal nǝ mǝlmǝ ndu gal lagu kǝra nda daɓaga tsǝya nyi ari.
Ama nandǝ uya lagu kǝra nda sǝni tsǝya nyi mai, ara ndǝr nyi a uyari vi wu ɗǝfuwa nji, ǝnga nandǝ wu yiwu ndǝr zǝmǝ a tǝɗau a gyiwu ˈyi mai.
